notes: Pictures: in Mark up, tap Picture to add a photo, a photo from the camera, or a page of a PDF
Drag a picture's corners to resize it, its sides to stretch it, the round handle to turn it; Crop and Turn are on its bar
Look: grey, black and white, remove white background (for signatures on paper), brightness, contrast, opacity
Border, flip, exact size and angle, reset, and make part of page are under More
Pictures open and save in the same format as the Windows app, so either app can edit them
The app now looks for updates once a day and asks before updating (you can turn this off in About)
